page_title: REN 2-0 NIC | Rennes v Nice 13/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Reda Belahyane (Nice) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball has crossed the sideline. Rennes are taking a throw-in.
90+5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) takes a rebound on the edge of the box and slams the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
90+3' Tom Louchet (Nice) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by Rennes is thwarted by the well prepared Marcin Bulka (Nice).
88' Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
88' Melvin Bard (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
86' Substitution. Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) replaces Fabian Rieder.
86' Julien Stephan has decided to make a change. Bertug Yildirim (Rennes) replaces Desire Doue.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Arnaud Kalimuendo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jeanuel Belocian (Rennes).
85' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
84' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Steve Mandanda has no trouble gathering it.
83' Fabian Rieder (Rennes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

83' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nice are going to take it.

81' What a chance that is! Tom Louchet swings the ball into the box, and Evann Guessand (Nice) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
80' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

80' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.
79' Warmed Omari (Rennes) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Bastien Dechepy ignores the protests.
78' Substitution. Morgan Sanson did his best and is replaced by Tom Louchet (Nice).
77' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Terem Moffi will be replaced by Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
77' Substitution. Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) in, Benjamin Bourigeaud out.
75' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
74' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
73' Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
73' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
71' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
71' Guela Doue (Rennes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

70' Desire Doue (Rennes) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rennes.
69' Terem Moffi (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
67' Guela Doue (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.
66' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
65' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Enzo Le Fee leaves the pitch to be replaced by Fabian Rieder (Rennes).
64' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Gaetan Laborde and he is replaced by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice).
64' Substitution. Reda Belahyane (Nice) on for Alexis Claude-Maurice.
62' Morgan Sanson (Nice) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

62' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Steve Mandanda makes a great save to stop his effort. Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.
60' The ball is cleared after Morgan Sanson (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
58' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Rennes will take a throw-in.
57' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) jumps into a tackle and Bastien Dechepy signals a foul.
56' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
54' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Enzo Le Fee laid the ball off to Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
53' Morgan Sanson (Nice) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
51' Martin Terrier (Rennes) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
48' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
47' Morgan Sanson (Nice) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
46' Terem Moffi (Nice) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Rennes.
46' Referee Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Pablo Rosario (Nice) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Morgan Sanson (Nice) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
45+1' Melvin Bard (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Nice force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for an infringement.
42' A cross into the box from Melvin Bard (Nice) is cleared.

41' Melvin Bard (Nice) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
40' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

39' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) sends the corner into the box, but Steve Mandanda intercepts it and averts the threat. Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
39' An attempted cross from Terem Moffi (Nice) is cleared. Nice force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

35' Enzo Le Fee (Rennes) attempts to put in the resulting set piece, but he miskicks and sends the ball into the stands. A strong but inaccurate shot. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
33' Evann Guessand (Nice) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the left post is denied by a decent save from Steve Mandanda.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Marcin Bulka.
31' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
30' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Rennes!
30' Referee Bastien Dechepy makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Rennes. Let’s see what happens!
29' That looked a certain handball by Pablo Rosario (Nice) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
29' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
28' Desire Doue (Rennes) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
28' Warmed Omari (Rennes) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Bastien Dechepy has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' Total attempts – 7:0.

24' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Marcin Bulka guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
24' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

23' Martin Terrier (Rennes) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Marcin Bulka pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner. Now Rennes have a corner.
21' Terem Moffi (Nice) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
20' Terem Moffi (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
19' Desire Doue (Rennes) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
17' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Marcin Bulka stops the ball from going into the top of the net.
14' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
13' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
13' Dante (Nice) makes a strong challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Rennes.

11' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
10' Dante (Nice) makes a rough challenge and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Melvin Bard (Nice) sends a long ball forward to Gaetan Laborde, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a throw-in.
6' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gaetan Laborde (Nice), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
2' Guela Doue (Rennes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Bastien Dechepy no option but to blow his whistle.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The match will be delayed.
Rennes will kick-off.
Bastien Dechepy got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
